title: One of the world’s biggest private market investors expands Asia push — betting on early-stage China deals and domestic demand
summary: Global private-markets investor EQT is doubling down on Asia as one of its strongest growth pillars.

title: Oxford Biomedica confirms takeover talks with biotech investor EQT
summary: Oxford, major contract manufacturer to cell and gene therapy companies, has already rejected multiple, unsolicited take-private bids from EQT that it felt “undervalued” the company and its prospects.
